comment: clockTrigger.process is called in two places in the same sample: first in the poly-copy condition, which is only reached when the reset jack holds a polyphonic cable, and then in the sequencing condition. A Rack SchmittTrigger returns true only on the first call after an edge, so with a polyphonic cable in the reset jack the copy consumes the clock and the sequence does not advance. The range switch rewrites minValue and maxValue on the eight knob quantities and then re-sets each knob, so knobs outside the new span are pulled in. The reset jack's meaning depends on the cable, so it has no family.
